file_roles.evidence: setGeometry only emitted Expose when m_oldGeometry was 0x0; the diff removes that old-geometry condition so every resize emits an expose event.
Same condition removal in setGeometry: m_oldGeometry.width()==0 && height()==0 dropped before handleExposeEvent.

rationale: The test fails because no Expose event follows a shrink. Both Android window classes had the same wrong condition that blocked expose on resize, and both are corrected.
